description: This file sets up and starts an Express.js server, defining server port and host configurations, handling graceful shutdown upon receiving SIGTERM signal, and exporting the server instance.

methods.name: app.listen
methods.description: Starts the Express application listening on specified port and host

methods.name: process.on
methods.description: Registers a listener for process signals, here used for graceful shutdown on SIGTERM

methods.name: server.close
methods.description: Stops the server from accepting new connections and calls callback when all connections are closed

methods.name: process.exit
methods.description: Terminates the process with the specified exit code after server shutdown
